about: ODIs missing from Cricsheet (abandoned, or no ball-by-ball file), added by tools/extra_odis.py. Found by comparing Wikipedia's season pages (International cricket in YYYY) with the fixtures; results, totals, toss, man of the match, top scorers and best bowling from the Wikipedia series pages. Real XIs are not available: xi 'series' = each side's most-used XI in the series (or its nearest real ODIs), with the captains and the named players put in; xi 'from:<cid>' = the XIs of that match. Bowling plans = the bowlers' average overs.
